name: Tiara of the Oracle
label: Quest
description: Tiara of the Oracle: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Twin Emperors... Their incessant whispers are slowly taking a toll on my sanity. They mock me, knowing I cannot step further into their domain to save my brother Arygos.
In my visions I see their monstrous faces adorned by powerful crowns. But I will have my revenge... I will transmute these symbols of Qiraji power to ones better suited to our needs.
Bring me the components I require, friend. I will give you a headpiece of unmatched power.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you bring me the components I asked for, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've succeeded! The whispers from the Twin Emperors have ceased.
Take this as a reward. The mere sight of it will strike fear in the hearts of the Qiraji... It shall remind them of their fallen leaders and of the mortal that slew them.
